correctness.rationale: The exact endpoint-product identity for every interval follows by prefix signs. Every sign vector with fixed initial +1 corresponds bijectively to a frequency, giving complete multiplicities. The zero, rank and exact smallest-positive singular-value formulas follow algebraically. Translation averaging proves globally optimal endpoint projection; Krawtchouk inversion gives its exact norm, crosschecked by independent integer Walsh transforms for n=3,8,15. Reproducible direct FWHT verifies n<=16 and independent raw interval parity sums verify n<=10. The infinite proof does not rely on finite tests.
